LOOK: Photos show the ongoing construction of a river wall along the San Juan River in Quezon City on Tuesday, July 29.

In his fourth State of the Nation Address, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. directed the Department of Public Works and Highways to submit a comprehensive list of all flood control projects initiated or completed in each region over the past three years, following the recent severe flooding that submerged communities and roads in Metro Manila and nearby provinces.

📸; Santi San Juan| MB
